description: P53 (plan M11 §2.5, §2.11): at the first shrine after loading a save whose look was made before clothing by slot (SaveSlots sets the flag appearance.slots_seen when it migrates the look; the load's message already said that nothing was changed), the Appearance tab now dresses the giant piece by piece. Dismissed when the Appearance tab is opened (appearance.tab_seen) or after 15 s.
text: Your giant's clothing is now worn piece by piece: change it at any shrine, in Appearance.
